errors.trigger: App stage name missing or unsafe
errors.diagnosis: The requested eval report path cannot be derived safely
errors.rescue_action: List valid stage names and ask the operator to pick one
errors.user_message: Stage name missing or unsafe. Valid stages: {stages}.

errors.trigger: App stage not implemented or artifacts/tests missing
errors.diagnosis: The stage to be checked has no implementation files to evaluate
errors.rescue_action: Halt and suggest running /fab-build for the named stage first
errors.user_message: Stage has not been implemented yet. Run /fab-build first.

errors.trigger: Quality score below threshold on any axis
errors.diagnosis: One or more quality axes scored below the blocking threshold (6/10)
errors.rescue_action: List blocking issues, set status = blocked, and suggest /fab-fix
errors.user_message: Quality score below 6/10 on one or more axes. Blocking issues: {issues}

errors.trigger: Candidate run object fails schema validation
errors.diagnosis: Quality score or next action update would corrupt run state
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and do not replace fabrica.run.json
errors.user_message: The candidate run state failed validation. No state was written.

errors.trigger: Eval report write/rename fails or is interrupted
errors.rescue_action: Keep original files, clean temp files if possible, and retry
errors.user_message: Could not write the eval report safely. Existing files were left unchanged where possible.
